notes: Inter is available in Figma and is used for the prototype.
Subscribed libraries were searched; their component APIs and density do not match NovaHub, so local components are preferred.
Code implementation remains Rust + Slint with platform system fonts.
The Starter plan permits at most three pages and one variable mode; the file structure was compressed without reducing prototype scope.
Figma local variable creation was unavailable in the current plugin context, so Foundations uses explicit documented token values.
The Starter MCP call limit was reached after Foundations layout correction; local interactive prototype evidence is the current visual source of truth.
NovaHub brand assets use three capability stars converging into a central Nova and are pending Figma sync.
prototype/components.html covers the 15 required official component types and their applicable states.
prototype/figma-sync-manifest.json defines ten deterministic boards, existing page IDs, evidence files and flow edges for direct synchronization.
